title.description: The complete title of the scientific document.

document_source_id.description: The unique ID of the source document (e.g., PMID, DOI).

analysis_date.description: The date when the data analysis was performed.

document_summary.description: A concise summary of the study's aim and main findings (e.g., 'Investigation of molecular changes following CITT ablation of 4T1 breast carcinoma in mouse models.').

therapy_type.description: The specific therapeutic method investigated in the document (e.g., CITT, Radiotherapy, Exercise).

dose_specificity.description: Details regarding the intensity, duration, or specifics of the dose, including any lack of dose comparisons (e.g., 'Partial ablation at 80-90°C; no dose-response comparisons reported.').

analyzed_biomarkers.description: A list of detailed objects, where each object fully describes an individual biomarker, its effect, and context.

biomarker_name.description: The molecular marker's name (e.g., Cxcl12, CK, Cortisol).

measured_tissue_or_fluid.description: The tissue or body fluid where the marker was quantified (e.g., Blood Serum, Muscle Biopsy, Saliva).

activity_type.description: The type of measurement (e.g., Gene Transcript, Protein Level, Hormone Concentration).

direction_of_change.description: The direction of the change after treatment or activity (e.g., higher, lower, unchanged).

magnitude_quantification.description: Precise measurement data or relative change, ideally including significance (e.g., 'Increased by 15%', '2 to 2.5-fold higher (P<0.05)').

core_biological_function.description: The fundamental biological role of the biomarker (e.g., mediates inflammation, tissue repair, energy metabolism regulation). This explains WHAT the biomarker does.

relevant_activity_context.description: The specific type of activity or condition linked to the change (e.g., Endurance running, High-intensity Interval Training (HIIT), Post-surgical recovery, 4T1 Carcinoma Ablation). This explains the specific WHEN/WHERE.

performance_or_health_indicator.description: The derived significance for performance, regeneration, or health status (e.g., 'Indicates muscle damage level', 'Predicts overtraining risk', 'Associated with heightened bone metastasis risk').

research_outlook.description: Recommendations for future studies or therapeutic interventions specifically related to this marker.
